stories.title: Flintshire woman jailed for eight years in Rhyl child sexual exploitation case
stories.summary: A woman from Flintshire has been jailed for eight years for perverting the course of justice and drug supply offences, following a child sexual exploitation investigation in Rhyl. stories.title: Commission proposes 3% rise in councillor pay across Wales
stories.summary: Councillors in Wales would get a 3 per cent pay rise in 2027-28, taking their basic salary to £21,676, under draft proposals published by the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru. stories.title: Man believed to have entered water at Flint Castle found dead at West Kirby Marine Lake
stories.summary: Detectives are appealing for anyone who was around Flint Castle on the evening of Monday 14 September, after a man was found dead at West Kirby Marine Lake two days later. stories.title: Coastguard helicopter and Flint lifeboat search River Dee after report of person in water
stories.summary: A search of the River Dee after a report of a possible person in the water at the Blue Bridge in Queensferry has been stood down, with nothing found. stories.summary: Homes in Shotton, Higher Shotton and Queensferry may have low pressure or no water this morning after a burst water main.
